name: Hotel Everest View and Khumjung
why: The rest-day walk from Namche: up to the terrace of the Hotel Everest View for tea in front of Everest and Ama Dablam, then through the Sherpa village of Khumjung.
book: Covered by the Sagarmatha National Park permit.
water: Tea at the hotel and in Khumjung.
dangers: You climb 450 m to almost 3,900 m: go slowly, this is the walk that helps you acclimatise.

points.name: Namche Bazaar
points.note: Leave the horseshoe town by the steps behind the monastery.

points.name: Hotel Everest View
points.note: A stone hotel at 3,880 m with a terrace facing Everest, Lhotse and Ama Dablam.

points.name: Khumjung
points.note: A Sherpa village of green roofs; its monastery keeps a 'yeti scalp'.
